Convergence

MSA iterations blend all-or-nothing auxiliary loadings with diminishing step sizes (α = 1/(m+1)) to converge toward user equilibrium. Final TSTT = 1,946,127,600 veh-seconds; final gap = 0.045283.

Macroscopic Fundamental Diagram (MFD)

Each point is one link, normalized to per-lane density so links with different lane counts are comparable. Dashed curve: theoretical VDF using median vf=83 km/h, kj=150 veh/km/lane. Left: speed–density. Centre: flow–density (inverted-U fundamental diagram). Right: unserved demand = demand − physical throughput. 1267/2931 links have unserved demand (total 249,275 veh/hr).

Correlation: MFD vs BPR

Scatter of per-link flow (left) and travel time (right): our density-based MFD assignment (100% demand, 2931 links) vs published BPR equilibrium (100% demand). Dashed line = y = x. Flow ρ = 0.975 (2931 matched links). Travel time ρ = 0.918 (2931 links).
